description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs -  Notify Consular Functions Act, with effect from 1st August 2018, Sri Lankan Refugees Living in India as at 31st July 2018 shall be exempted from the Consular Fees applicable to registration of births and deaths
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification issued under the Consular Functions Act, No. 04 of 1981, which pertains to a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the Minister of Foreign Affairs exercising powers vested in him by an existing Act to exempt a specific group from certain consular fees. The core content is about the modification/application of a legal regulation (fee exemption), not about government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or elections.
